reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The transaction envisages the provision of a long-term loan secured loan of up to €25 milion to Orzax Central Asia LLP, a newly created subsidiary of ORZAKS ILAC VE KIMYA SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI, a joint stock company organised in the Republic of Turkey, for the construction and putting into operation a food supplement production plant in Kazakhstan. The proceeds of the Bank's investment will be used for the construction, procurement of equipment and putting into operation of a new plant for the production of food supplements in the Turkistan region, Kazakhstan.
